verdict.rationale: Kling documents a first-party RESTful API with JWT AccessKey/SecretKey auth, global and China endpoints, and an MCP/CLI entry point. Its per-unit pricing table covers several generation modes (text/image-to-video, start/end frame, motion control, video input, audio), though that table is only implicitly tied to the API. Nothing claims parity with the UI, and UI features such as the Agent workflow, Skills, the node canvas, Elements and mask re-editing are not shown as API-accessible. Missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity statement, documented API coverage of Agent, Skills, node editing, Elements and mask re-editing, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: RESTful API with JWT-based authentication (AccessKey + SecretKey)
